description: ERNIE Light DT 1.0 (Intl) is Baidu's text model with Baidu Sparse Attention for working with long conversations and documents. It supports tool calling, structured output, a 1,024,000-token context window, and up to 131,072 output tokens. Choose max, high, or low reasoning effort, or none to disable reasoning.
name: ERNIE Light DT 1.0 (Intl)
